MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Shawn Ridgell, Esq. appeared with plaintiff Saeed Khan.
No appearance by defendants Union Cab Co. and Truong M. Quang.
Defaults entered against defendants on December 12, 2007.
Doe defendants dismissed on December 12, 2007.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff SAEED KHAN, and against the Defaulted Defendants UNION CAB CO. and TRUONG M. QUANG as follows:

Damages/Principal - $27,000.00
Costs - $492.59, for a total of $27,492.59.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
